test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: If the diameter of the base of a cone is 56 cm and its curved surface area is 3080 cm², then what will be its volume (in cm³)? (Use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Radius (r) = 56 ÷ 2 = 28 cm.

Slant height (l) = CSA ÷ (πr) = 3080 ÷ (22/7 × 28) = 35 cm.

Using Pythagorean triplet (3, 4, 5) × 7 → (21, 28, 35), height (h) = √(35² − 28²) = 21 cm.

Volume = 1/3 × πr²h = 1/3 × 22/7 × 28² × 21 = 17248 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 17248 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Diameter of the base = 56 cm

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 3080 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Radius (r) = Diameter ÷ 2

CSA = πrl (where l is the slant height)

l² = r² + h²

Volume = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53eb423211b118a6f9846d40025f9e3f99f71dc58ce7ab20b929fa13adf6ea11.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Radius (r) = 56 ÷ 2 = 28 cm

⇒ πrl = 3080

⇒ (22/7) × 28 × l = 3080

⇒ 88 × l = 3080

⇒ l = 3080 ÷ 88 = 35 cm

⇒ h = √(l² − r²)

⇒ h = √(35² − 28²)

⇒ h = √(1225 − 784) = √441 = 21 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 28 × 28 × 21

⇒ Volume = 22 × 4 × 28 × 7

⇒ Volume = 17248 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 17248 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cone

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the circular base: TSA = πr(r + l).

Volume of a Cylinder

A cylinder with the same base radius and height as a cone has exactly three times its volume. Volume = πr²h.

Frustum of a Cone

When a cone is cut by a plane parallel to its base, the lower part is a frustum. Volume = (1/3)πh(R² + r² + Rr).
